windows_dark.notes: Ring tiles of rest, default (accent #4CC2FF), pressed and disabled are the light ring tables mapped; hover is a #3C3C3C face with the grey ring (Windows 11 dark has no accent ring on hover); pressed is #323232 with the grey ring, accent ring when default; dotted focus rectangle inverted to light dots. Sheets: windows-dark/button.png (and @1.5x). Palette mapping: Derived, not captured: v3 has no dark mode. The baked light tiles are painted through winpx.dark_argb: each pixel's grey goes through a per-family curve (check/radio mark: face #F3 to #2B2B2B, rest border #78 to #9A9A9A, pressed border #C8 to about #686868; edit chrome: face to #2B2B2B, rim to #323232..#3A3A3A, foot line #AB to #9A9A9A; button ring: line #D0 to #6B6B6B, disabled line to #3A3A3A), an accent blue is read as a mix of the light accent and white or the face and painted as the same mix of #4CC2FF and black (tick) or the face (underline), alpha kept, so the antialiasing structure is the capture's. Tokens: #202020 ground, button #333333 / hover #3C3C3C / pressed #323232 / disabled #2B2B2B with #787878 text, edit #2B2B2B, selection #264F78, focus dots light.
windows_dark.gaps: Hover and pressed faces and the stroke greys are Windows 11 palette values, not measured; the pressed default keeps the light table's bevel. No live reference exists for a Windows dark v3.
